title: The public Space page gives the owner's blocks the full width again, as the DAWN page did, and every Space page wears its website's fonts

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-16: The public space design looks broken. We had a way better design in the Dawn system. Use that presentation with Frequency themes. And make sure all the design fonts sync from space to website to public space.

detail: Signed out, /spaces/<slug> set the body beside a 320px key-facts column (SCAN-883), so every two-cell row was squeezed: on The Group the Memberships cell fell to about 300px and its title broke one word per line. The DAWN page gave the blocks the whole column with the visitor's way in at the foot. The body now runs the full width again and the key facts (FqSpaceFacts) sit under it as one band of cards that wrap side by side. Fonts: a Space whose page is synced to a Network or Wildheart website wore a stand-in set (Modern, Classic) on its Space page and share page while the website wore Bricolage Grotesque over Outfit, or IM Fell English over EB Garamond. spacePageSiteFaces (lib/theme/site-style.ts) picks the website's faces, AccentScope stamps them as data-space-fonts and loads them from Google Fonts (lib/theme/site-faces.ts, the sheet network-page-scope already used), on both the member layout and the public layout, and the facts cards and tagline now speak the Space's faces too.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];const css=r('app/themes/frequency/space-page.css');const a=r('components/spaces/accent-scope.tsx');const f=r('lib/theme/site-faces.ts');const ss=r('lib/theme/site-style.ts');if(/\\.fqs-cols\\{[^}]*grid-template-columns:minmax\\(0,1fr\\) \\d+px/.test(css))bad.push('the public body is squeezed beside a facts column');if(!/\\.fqs-cols\\{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax\\(0,1fr\\);/.test(css))bad.push('the public body does not run full width');if(!/\\[data-space-fonts=\"network\"\\]\\s*\\{[^}]*--font-nw-bricolage/.test(css)||!/\\[data-space-fonts=\"wildheart\"\\]\\s*\\{[^}]*--font-wh-fell/.test(css))bad.push('the Space page has no website faces');if(!f.includes('SITE_FACE_SHEETS')||!a.includes('SITE_FACE_SHEETS[faces]'))bad.push('AccentScope loads no website faces');if(!ss.includes('export function spacePageSiteFaces'))bad.push('no synced-faces reader');for(const p of ['app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/layout.tsx','app/(public)/spaces/[slug]/layout.tsx'])if(!r(p).includes('siteFaces={spacePageSiteFaces(space.preferences)}'))bad.push(p+' passes no website faces');if(!/\\[data-space-fonts\\] :is\\(\\.fqs-card-t/.test(css))bad.push('the facts cards ignore the Space faces');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-985: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
